address.question: I do not know my salon's address.
address.answer: Just type its name above. The exact link is also in the confirmation email for your last appointment, and the salon can send it to you.

account.question: Do I need an account to book?
account.answer: Yes. You are free to browse services and availability; the account is created when you book, in seconds. It is what then lets you find all your appointments, and reschedule or cancel them online.

reschedule.question: How do I reschedule or cancel an appointment?
reschedule.answer: From “{door}”, in your salon's client area, for as long as the notice period the salon has set allows. The salon is notified automatically.

card.question: Is my card data stored?
card.answer: No. Payment is entrusted to Stripe: your card data goes straight from your browser to Stripe, and never through our servers.

price.question: How much does the platform cost a salon?
price.answer: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} free, then {price} a month, with no commitment. Your card is registered by Stripe when you sign up and is only charged at the end of the trial; you can cancel whenever you like from your back office.

staff.question: I work in a salon: how do I sign in?
staff.answer: Enter the salon above, then choose “{door}”. Your credentials are issued to you by the salon's management.

consent.summary: What we do with your data

identity.why: identify your appointment at the salon. Required: without them, there is no booking to honour.

email.why: send you the confirmation, then any cancellation or reschedule notice. Required: it is the channel the salon replies on.

emailAccount.why: send you the confirmation, then any cancellation or reschedule notice. Required: it is the channel the salon replies on. It is also your sign-in name.

phone.why: send you the reminder by SMS the day before. Optional: without a number, the reminder comes by email only.

note.why: pass on to the practitioner what they need to know for the service. Optional: only write what the salon needs on the day.

password.why: protect access to your account. Required, and kept encrypted: nobody, at the salon or here, can read it back.

consent.rights: The salon keeps this data for as long as it follows up with its clients. You can view it, correct it or ask for its deletion at any time, from your account or by writing to the salon.
consent.error: tick this box to continue: without your consent, we cannot process your data

heading.title: Data policy

controller.title: Who processes your data
controller.body: <salon>{salonName}</salon> decides what is collected and what is done with it: the salon is your point of contact, and the requests set out below are addressed to it. This booking platform hosts and processes that data on its behalf, and for no other purpose.
controller.isolation: Your data stays with this salon: it is not shared with any other salon using the same platform.

purposes.checkboxWording: The checkbox on that screen reads, word for word: <quote>“{label}”</quote>

legalBasis.title: On what basis, and what we keep as proof
legalBasis.blocking: The checkbox on both screens is blocking: the form does not go through until it is ticked.
legalBasis.proof: Whether you book an appointment or create an account, that agreement is also recorded with the exact date and time at which you gave it, because the salon must be able to demonstrate that it received it. In both cases the request is refused without it — including when it reaches us by some route other than the form.
legalBasis.serverClock: That timestamp is taken by our servers at the moment your agreement reaches us: it is never supplied by the device you are writing from, so that it keeps its value as proof.
legalBasis.serviceMessages: Three processing activities do not depend on it, and that has to be said: your appointment confirmation, the day-before reminder and the cancellation notice are part of performing the service you asked for. Switching them off would deprive you of exactly what you came for.

recipients.title: Who else sees it
recipients.team: The salon team — the people who keep the diary and run the counter.
recipients.senders: The sending services — an email provider and an SMS provider, which receive your address or your number for as long as it takes to deliver the message, and nothing else.
recipients.paymentProvider: The payment provider — if you pay online. Your card details are entered with them and never reach our servers: we keep nothing but an opaque reference, which allows neither replaying a payment nor reconstructing a number.
recipients.noSale: No data is sold, exchanged or passed on to a third party for commercial purposes.

retention.title: How long, and your rights
retention.anonymisation: A deletion request does not erase the accounting record of payments already taken, which the business is required to keep: your record is anonymised instead — name, contact details and notes removed — and what is left can no longer be linked to you.
retention.selfService: You can correct your contact details yourself from <account>your client area</account>. For an export or a deletion, write to the salon — it is your point of contact and has the tools to answer.
